info.name: E-Commerce API - Organized by Roles
info.description:
# E-Commerce Multi-Vendor Platform API
## Organized by User Roles

This collection is organized by the 6 user roles in the system for better navigation and testing.

## 🎭 Roles Overview

### 🌐 Common (Public & Shared)
Endpoints accessible to all users or shared functionality:
- System health & monitoring
- Authentication (login, register, password reset)
- Search (products, autocomplete)
- Notifications

### 🛍️ Customer (End Users)
Shopping and consumer-facing endpoints:
- Browse & search products
- Cart management
- Checkout & payments
- Order tracking
- Wishlist & wallet
- Returns & reviews

### 🏪 Vendor (Merchants)
Business owner and staff endpoints:
- Product management (in Products folder)
- Sub-order management
- Inventory tracking
- Payout viewing

### 👨‍💼 Admin (Order & Catalog Managers)
Administrative team endpoints:
- Order management & refunds
- Coupon management
- Review moderation (in Reviews folder)

### ⚡ Super Admin (Full Control)
Platform administration endpoints:
- User management
- Vendor approval
- Category management
- Shipping & tax configuration
- Commission & payout management
- System settings

## 🚀 Quick Start
1. Import this collection and environment file
2. Run "Health Check" in Common folder
3. Login using appropriate role credentials
4. Navigate to your role's folder for relevant endpoints

## 🔑 Test Credentials

**Super Admin:**
- Email: admin@ecommerce.com
- Password: Admin@123

**Customer (Register new):**
- Use "Authentication → Register - Customer"

**Vendor (Apply & get approved):**
- Use "Vendors → Register Vendor"
- Then admin approves via "Vendors → Approve Vendor"

## 📊 Role Permissions

| Role | Users | Vendors | Products | Orders | Settings |
|------|-------|---------|----------|--------|----------|
| SUPER_ADMIN | ✅ All | ✅ All | ✅ All | ✅ All | ✅ All |
| ADMIN_ORDER_MANAGER | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Manage | ❌ |
| ADMIN_CATALOG_MANAGER | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Approve | ❌ | ❌ |
| VENDOR_OWNER | ❌ | ✅ Own | ✅ Own | ✅ Own | ❌ |
| VENDOR_STAFF | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Update | ✅ View | ❌ |
| CUSTOMER | ❌ | ❌ | 👁️ View | ✅ Own | ❌ |

## 🎯 Testing Flow by Role

**Customer Journey:**
1. Common → Register/Login
2. Customer → Browse Products
3. Customer → Add to Cart
4. Customer → Checkout
5. Customer → Track Order
6. Customer → Write Review

**Vendor Journey:**
1. Common → Register Vendor
2. Super Admin → Approve Vendor
3. Common → Login as Vendor
4. Customer → Create Products (vendor endpoints)
5. Vendor → Manage Sub-orders
6. Vendor → Track Inventory

**Admin Journey:**
1. Common → Login as Admin
2. Admin → Manage Orders
3. Admin → Create Coupons
4. Customer → Moderate Reviews

## 💡 Notes
- All endpoints include comprehensive tests
- Automatic token management configured
- Dynamic test data generation enabled
- Newman CLI compatible for CI/CD

## 📝 Version
Collection Version: 2.0 (Role-based organization)
Last Updated: 2026-08-03

item.name: System
item.description: System health and status endpoints. Start here to verify the API is running.

request.description:
Check system health and status of all services.

**Purpose:** Verify that the API and all its dependencies (database, Redis, BullMQ queues) are operational.

**Authentication:** None required

**Response includes:**
- Overall system status
- Database connection status
- Redis connection status
- BullMQ queues status (email, sms, payout, notification)
- Server uptime
- Current environment

**Use this to:**
- Verify API is running before executing other requests
- Monitor system health
- Check service dependencies

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication and authorization endpoints. Start with Register or Login to get access tokens.

request.description:
Register a new customer account.

**Authentication:** None required

**Required Fields:**
- email (unique, valid email)
- password (min 8 characters)
- name

**Response:**
- User object
- Access token (JWT, expires in 15 minutes)
- Refresh token (expires in 7 days)

**Tokens are automatically stored** in environment variables for use in subsequent requests.

**Default Role:** CUSTOMER

**Example Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "role": "CUSTOMER"
    },
    "accessToken": "jwt-token",
    "refreshToken": "refresh-token"
  }
}
```

Authenticate with admin credentials.

**Authentication:** None required

**Required Fields:**
- email
- password

**Response:**
- User object with role information
- Access token (stored automatically)
- Refresh token (stored automatically)

**Admin Credentials (after seeding):**
- Email: admin@ecommerce.com
- Password: Admin@123

**Use this to:**
- Get admin access for testing
- Access protected admin endpoints
- Manage the platform

Get a new access token using refresh token.

**Authentication:** None required (uses refresh token in body)

**When to use:**
- Access token has expired
- Need to extend session

**Note:** Refresh token is automatically sent from stored environment variable.

Logout current user and invalidate tokens.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**What happens:**
- Current refresh token is invalidated
- Client should discard access token

**Note:** This request will clear stored tokens from environment.

Change password for authenticated user.

**Authentication:** Required

**Required Fields:**
- currentPassword
- newPassword (min 8 chars)
- confirmPassword (must match newPassword)

**Security:**
- Old password is verified
- New password must be different
- Password strength validated

Request password reset email.

**Authentication:** None required

**Required Fields:**
- email

**What happens:**
- If email exists, a reset token is sent
- Email contains reset link with token
- Token expires in 1 hour

**Note:** In development, check console logs for reset token if email is not configured.

Reset password using reset token.

**Authentication:** None required (uses token from email)

**Required Fields:**
- token (from email)
- password (new password)
- confirmPassword

**Token Requirements:**
- Must be valid
- Must not be expired
- Can only be used once
